input: Find small art studios, dance studios, music teachers and gyms that run a few weeks of summer camp for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania, Polk, Haywood and Jackson counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon, Waynesville, Sylva). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville art dance gymnastics summer camp 2026 studio

candidates.name: Art of Dance Studio
candidates.note: Three weeklong 2026 camps for ages 3+, with dance, optional acting and voice lessons, crafts and games.

candidates.name: Relevé Performing Arts Center
candidates.note: Summer dance camps, classes and a weeklong intensive for competitive dancers.

candidates.name: Angel Art Studios
candidates.note: Molly Angel’s children’s art camp appeared in the 2025 WNC day-camp guide.

candidates.name: FighterWithin Mixed Martial Arts
candidates.note: Weeklong summer kids camps documented in June and July 2025 at its martial-arts facility.

candidates.name: MusicWorks! Studio of Performing Arts
candidates.note: Weeklong, small-group summer camps combine dance, music, theater, crafts and performance.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included SASY visual/performing arts, PacJAM Appalachian music and a theater camp.

candidates.name: Tryon Little Theater
candidates.note: Co-ran the weeklong 2025 and 2026 theater camps at Tryon Fine Arts Center.
